CWI logo  Postdoc/researcher (m/f/x) Centrum Wiskunde & Informatica (CWI) has a vacancy in the QuSoft research group for a talented Postdoc/researcher (m/f/x)on the subject of characterisation, learning and testing in bosonic quantum computers.  Job description Theoretical models of quantum computers typically consist of qubits. Physics, however, naturally provides us with other natural modalities of quantum computing. First among these is bosonic quantum computing, which has seen substantial experimental progress, but comparatively little work on the theoretical computer science side. The goal of this postdoc position is to perform research on property testing, learning theory and characterisation of bosonic quantum systems, as well as the classical simulation of bosonic quantum computation. This position is established as part of the Quantera consortium Batir-le-chat, which brings together researchers from the Netherlands, Germany and France to work on the theoretical aspects of bosonic quantum computing. Requirements We are looking for an excellent scientist with expertise in quantum computing and quantum information processing in general, with a strong interest in bosonic quantum computing and/or characterisation or testing/learning theory. Needed qualifications for candidates include proven research talent and good academic writing and presentation skills. Candidates are expected to have an excellent command of English. Terms and conditions The terms of employment are in accordance with the Dutch Collective Labour Agreement for Research Centres ("CAO-onderzoeksinstellingen"). The gross monthly salary for an employee on a full time basis, depending on relevant work experience, ranges from € 4,374 to € 5,758. The appointment will be for a period of one year, with the option to extend 1.5 more years (for a total of 2.5) by mutual agreement. jobs.description: Is it time for you to start searching for an internship? Do you breathe hospitality and are you more than excited to broaden your knowledge? Stop your search and join us to experience authentic hospitality in one of Amsterdam's most iconic hotels.Park Plaza Victoria Amsterdam is located in the heart of the city, directly opposite Amsterdam Central Station. Combining historic architecture with contemporary comfort, the hotel welcomes both leisure and business guests from around the world.As a Front Office Intern, you will be the face of the hotel and play a key role in creating memorable guest experiences. You will gain hands-on experience in all aspects of Front Office operations while developing your professional and hospitality skills in a dynamic international environment.The internship starts in September 2026 for a period of 5 or 6 monthsResponsibilities• Communicate effectively with colleagues and guests, contributing to a positive team environment and consistent service delivery• Support the guest journey, including check-ins, check-outs, and handling guest requests across phone, written, and face-to-face communication• Assist with reservations, payments, and Front Office administrative tasks• Deliver excellent guest service and respond professionally to guest enquiries• Maintain a professional and welcoming Front Office environment in line with brand standards• Collaborate with departments such as Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, and Maintenance to ensure smooth daily operations• Learn and apply hotel procedures, standards, and systems to support operational excellenceEssential Requirements• Currently enrolled in a hospitality or related study program• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)• Proactive attitude with willingness to learn and develop• Guest-focused mindset with a positive and professional approach• Enjoys working in a team and adapting to a fast-paced environment• Available for an interns
